title: Barrels Of TNT
description: Turns the TNT block into a Barrel of TNT
body:
This resource pack replaces the classic _TNT block_ with a **Barrel of TNT**. The TNT texture is redesigned to look like a strapped explosive barrel, and the in-game name is changed from “TNT” to “Barrel of TNT.”


Please note that the custom name currently only displays correctly when using the _English (US) language_; other languages will still show the default TNT name.
